in_sanskrit.name: असित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Asita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'asita' which means 'dawn' or 'beginning of day'. It is a significant name in Hindu mythology as it is used to refer to a sage named Asita who was present during the Samudra Manthana or the churning of the ocean by the gods and demons.

in_hindi.name: असित
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Asita can be translated to 'Shubhraatri' or 'Prakritika'. Shubhraatri means 'auspicious' or 'fortunate' and Prakritika means 'natural' or 'basic'. These translations further emphasize the significance of the name Asita which means 'dawn' or 'beginning of day'.

in_tamil.name: ஆசிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Asita can be translated to 'Aasitha' or 'Aasithaa'. The meaning of these Tamil translations are 'bright' and 'goddess' respectively. This further emphasizes the importance of the name Asita which represents the dawn or the beginning of a new day.

in_telugu.name: ఆశేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Asita can be translated to 'Aashaya' or 'Aadheyeesha'. Aashaya means 'hope' or 'expectation' and Aadheyeesha means 'lord of the senses'. These translations further highlight the significance of the name Asita which means 'dawn' or 'beginning of day'.

in_marathi.name: Asita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Seer of the Future
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who sees or knows the future. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘as’ meaning ‘to see’ and ‘ita’ meaning ‘that’. In Hindu mythology, Asita is the name of a sage who could foresee the future.

in_bengali.name: Asita
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Seer of the Future
